questions.chapter: Chapter 1: Water Demand Estimation & Population Forecasting Methods
questions.text: Explain Objectives of Water Supply Systems. Explain water-borne diseases (Cholera, Typhoid, Dysentery) and their prevention methods.

questions.chapter: Chapter 2: Sources of Water & River/Reservoir Intake Structures

questions.chapter: Chapter 4: Water Treatment Systems
